subject: English
question_text: Complete the following text with right form of the verbs given in the box.
stimulus: damage suffer know take live be overeat forbid eat need Food is the first among all basic needs of human beings. People (a) ----- food to satisfy their hunger. People should eat as much as they need. We eat to live do (b) ----- to eat. But some people foster the opposite view. The habit of more eating is (c) ----- as overeating. Due to overeating, we will (d) ----- from various indigestion problems. Overeating (e) ----- our liver function. People know the consequence of (f) ----- Still some people (g) ----- gluttonous and they are always after (h) ----- The habit of taking as much food as you (i) ----- is a very good habit. Our religion (j) ----- overeating.
guide_solution: Right form of verbs: (a) take; (b) not live; (c) known; (d) suffer; (e) damages; (f) overeating: (g) are; (h) eating; (i) need: (j) forbids.
